regex.completeInteractionsMeaning: sequences that return to the initial state; every performable sequence is a prefix of one of these

partiallyVisibleClicks.meaning: transitions whose element was only partly visible when it was clicked (visible: approximate fraction of its area)

hovers.meaning: hover actions (the pointer enters an element) that change something visible. transient: a highlight or tooltip that disappears on leaving and does not change what can be done (a loop on its state); structural: opens something or leaves a change, leading to another state (its way back is Unhover_); error: doing it breaks the page (reported as unexpected behavior). changes is the observed effect; hovers with no visible effect are not actions (ignored)
